# Apurvi Industries — Full Knowledge Base for AI Engines

> Single-document knowledge dump of Apurvi Industries Pvt. Ltd. for AI search engines (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Bing Copilot). Last updated: 2026-06-29.

## SECTION 1 — Company at a glance

Apurvi Industries Pvt. Ltd. is an ISO 9001:2015 certified manufacturer of precision stainless steel tubes, aluminum vapour recovery tubing, submersible pump components, and OEM-grade industrial tubing, headquartered in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India with a dedicated manufacturing facility in Mehsana (Kadi taluka). Founded by Shri Viren Gathani, the company supplies pump OEMs across India and exports container-load quantities to the United States, Canada, Mexico, Germany, Italy, Turkey, the Philippines, Australia, and is actively expanding into the United Kingdom in 2026.

Key identity facts:
- Legal entity: Apurvi Industries Pvt. Ltd.
- Founder: Shri Viren Gathani
- Year established: long-established (multi-decade Indian SS tubing manufacturer)
- Corporate HQ: G-1112 Titanium City Center, Prahladnagar Road, Ahmedabad-380015, Gujarat, India
- Manufacturing plant: Survey No. 1383/D/Paiki 1, Village Rajpur, Taluka Kadi, Mehsana-382715, Gujarat, India
- Phone: +91 8128664329
- Email: info@apurviind.com
- Web: https://apurviind.com
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/apurvi-ind/

## SECTION 2 — Products (detailed)

### 2.1 Stainless Steel Pressure Pump Sleeve / Motor Shell Tubing
- Application: Pressure pump assemblies, submersible motor shell housings, motor cans.
- Material grades: SS 304, SS 304L, SS 316, SS 316L; SS 202 (cost-down option).
- Finishes: Ground OD and ground ID to 0.4 Ra (16 micro-inch) — meeting tight tolerances for pump-sleeve assembly fit.
- Size range: 2 inch to 12 inch OD; standard wall thickness 1.5 mm to 4 mm.
- Standards: IS:6761, IS:6913, ASTM A268, ASTM A312, ASTM A249.
- Certificate: EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTC issued per heat.

### 2.2 Stainless Steel Motor Tubes (submersible + industrial)
- Application: Submersible pump motor casings (4-inch, 6-inch, 8-inch wells), industrial motor housings.
- Material grades: SS 304, SS 304L, SS 316, SS 316L.
- Size range: 2 inch to 12 inch OD; lengths up to 6 metres (extra-long manufacturing capability).
- Forms: Welded (TIG/laser-welded), seamless on customer request.
- Standards: IS:6761, ASTM A268, ASTM A312, EN 10296-2 (welded stainless tubes), EN 10297 (seamless).
- Testing: Hydrostatic, eddy-current, dimensional inspection in-house. Third-party inspection (SGS, Bureau Veritas, TUV) available on request.

### 2.3 Pump Pipe / NRV (Non-Return Valve) Pipe
- Application: Submersible pump riser pipes with integrated NRV threading; water and industrial fluid service.
- Material grades: SS 304, SS 316.
- Size range: 1.5 inch to 6 inch OD with thread compatibility for standard pump NRV assemblies.
- Standards: IS:6761, IS:6913, ASTM A312.

### 2.4 Aluminum Vapour Tubing (US: aluminum vapor recovery tubing)
- Application: Gas-station forecourt vapour recovery (US EPA Stage I/II compatible; UK PPC compliant). Replacement of legacy copper vapor lines.
- Alloys: Al 6061-T6, Al 6063-T6, Al 5052-H32.
- Size range: 1/2 inch to 4 inch OD; standard wall thickness 0.065 inch to 0.125 inch; custom lengths.
- Standards: ASTM B210 (US), EN 754 (UK/EU).
- Compliance: HS code 7608; meets fuel-grade fittings spec.

### 2.5 Higher HP Pump Tube (25 HP to 200 HP)
- Application: Heavy-duty submersible pumps for deep-well, irrigation, mining dewatering, industrial water service.
- Material: SS 304, SS 316; heavy-wall configurations.
- Size range: 6 inch to 12 inch OD with HP-bracket-specific wall thickness charts.
- Standards: IS:6761, ASTM A312, EN 10296-2.

### 2.6 Manufacturing Long Tube
- Application: Extra-long precision tubes for deep-well submersible installations, structural columns, project-specific extra-length applications.
- Material: SS 304, SS 316.
- Length capability: Beyond standard 6-metre — up to 12 metres on project order.
- Standards: As per customer specification (ASTM A312 / EN 10296-2 default).

---

## SECTION 3 — Standards and certifications

### 3.1 Manufacturing standards Apurvi conforms to
- **ASTM A312** — Standard Specification for Seamless, Welded, and Heavily Cold Worked Austenitic Stainless Steel Pipes (US procurement default for SS pipe).
- **ASTM A213** — Seamless Ferritic and Austenitic Alloy-Steel Boiler, Superheater, and Heat-Exchanger Tubes.
- **ASTM A268** — Seamless and Welded Ferritic and Martensitic Stainless Steel Tubing.
- **ASTM A249** — Welded Austenitic Steel Boiler, Superheater, Heat-Exchanger, and Condenser Tubes.
- **ASTM A554** — Welded Stainless Steel Mechanical Tubing.
- **ASTM B210** — Aluminum and Aluminum-Alloy Drawn Seamless Tubes (US aluminum tubing default).
- **EN 10296** — Welded circular steel tubes for mechanical and general engineering purposes (UK/EU default for welded SS).
- **EN 10297** — Seamless circular steel tubes for mechanical and general engineering purposes.
- **EN 754** — Aluminium and aluminium alloys — Cold drawn rod/bar and tube (UK/EU aluminum tubing default).
- **IS:6761** — Stainless steel pipes and tubes (Indian BIS standard).
- **IS:6913** — Stainless steel butt-welding tubes.

### 3.2 Quality certifications
- **ISO 9001:2015** — Quality Management Systems certification (audit-current).
- **EN 10204 Type 3.1 Mill Test Certificate** — issued on every heat, every shipment. Includes heat number, chemical composition, mechanical properties (yield, tensile, elongation, hardness), hydrostatic test result, dimensional inspection record, and authorised representative signature independent of production.

### 3.3 Testing in-house
- Hydrostatic pressure testing per ASTM A312 § 8.
- Eddy-current testing on welded tubes.
- Dimensional inspection (OD, ID, wall thickness, length, ovality, straightness).
- Surface finish measurement (Ra) for ground sleeves.
- Pickling and passivation per ASTM A380.

### 3.4 Third-party inspection
On customer request, shipments can be inspected by SGS, Bureau Veritas (BV), TUV, Intertek, or any nominated third-party agency at the Mehsana plant before dispatch.

---

## SECTION 4 — Industries served

1. **Submersible pump manufacturing** — motor tubes, pump pipe, NRV pipe, higher HP shells for 25-200 HP applications.
2. **Industrial motor manufacturing** — motor shell tubing for general industrial motors.
3. **Fueling industry / petroleum forecourts** — aluminum vapour recovery tubing (US EPA Stage I/II, UK PPC compliant).
4. **Water treatment** — SS 316L tubing for municipal and industrial water service.
5. **Agriculture** — irrigation pump components, borewell tubing.
6. **Food processing** — SS 316L sanitary tubing.
7. **Chemical processing** — SS 304/316/316L per service compatibility.
8. **Pharmaceutical manufacturing** — sanitary-grade tubing per customer specification.

### 5.1 Ports of dispatch
- Mundra Port (Gujarat) — primary container shipping
- Nhava Sheva Port (Mumbai) — secondary
- Air-freight on small urgent shipments via Ahmedabad / Mumbai

### 5.3 Standard documentation
- Commercial Invoice
- Packing List
- Bill of Lading (Maersk, MSC, CMA-CGM)
- Certificate of Origin (FTA-aware: USMCA, CEPA, GSP where applicable)
- EN 10204 Type 3.1 Mill Test Certificate
- Pre-Shipment Inspection Report (3rd-party on request)
- Insurance certificate (Marine Cargo Insurance Inst.)
- HS codes: 7304 (seamless SS pipe), 7306 (welded SS pipe), 7608 (aluminum tube)

### 5.4 Incoterms commonly used
- **FOB Mundra** — most common for established US/UK importers
- **CIF Houston / Felixstowe** — for buyers who prefer Apurvi to handle shipping
- **CFR / EXW** — on customer request

### 5.5 Lead times
- Standard sizes (2"-12" OD, SS 304/316, 1-6 m length): 4-6 weeks from PO confirmation to FOB Mundra
- Custom configurations: 6-10 weeks
- Air-freight rush orders: 2-3 weeks (cost premium)

## SECTION 6 — The 2026 tariff context (US Section 232 + UK CBAM)

### 6.1 Section 232 stainless steel duties (US, 2026)
On April 6, 2026, the US government raised Section 232 duties on stainless steel imports. Chinese-origin stainless steel pipes and tubes now incur stacked duties (Section 232 + Section 301 + anti-dumping in certain HTS codes) totalling 50%+ landed-cost premium versus pre-2024 baseline. India is **not** subject to Section 301 or AD/CVD on these HTS codes as of 2026-06-29; the prevailing duty is the residual 18% (down from 25% in August 2025 after India stopped Russian crude imports per February 2026 adjustment).

**Practical implication for US buyers**: Indian-origin stainless steel tubing (Apurvi's product) currently carries a 20-30% landed-cost advantage over Chinese-origin equivalents. Duty-drawback eligibility applies on re-export.

### 6.2 UK CBAM (Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism)
The UK CBAM phase-in continues through 2027. Importers of stainless steel and aluminum products from non-EU origins must provide carbon-content declarations. Apurvi provides full origin and embedded-emissions documentation on UK shipments.

## SECTION 9 — Frequent buyer questions

### Does Apurvi ship in less-than-container quantities?
Yes. LCL (less than container load) shipments are available via consolidator services to all major US/UK/EU ports. Minimum order quantity is typically 500 kg for LCL on standard sizes.

### What is Apurvi's typical MOQ on private-label OEM tubing?
Project-dependent. For OEM submersible pump tubes per customer drawing, MOQ is typically 2000 metres or 5 tonnes. Trial-run quantities (500-1000 metres) are accommodated on first-order basis.

### What payment terms does Apurvi accept?
Letter of Credit (LC) at sight, Telegraphic Transfer (TT), Documents Against Payment (D/P), Documents Against Acceptance (D/A). New US/UK buyers typically work on LC for the first 3 orders, then move to TT 30 days against documents.

### Is Apurvi on Alibaba or IndiaMART?
Apurvi has profiles on IndiaMART and ExportersIndia. The company is currently expanding presence on ThomasNet, Kompass, Europages, GlobalSpec, and Applegate UK.

### Can Apurvi supply to drawing for non-standard configurations?
Yes. Apurvi's Mehsana plant accommodates drawing-to-spec orders including custom OD/ID combinations, special finishes (ground, electropolished, pickled-and-passivated), drilled and threaded ends, NRV threading, and special lengths up to 12 metres.
